Landing.metaTitle: You play. We count the chips.

hero.title: You play. We count the chips.
hero.description: Buy-ins, rebuys, blinds and pots: {appName} keeps the bank on the living-room TV, and everyone bets from their phone.
hero.photoAlt: Friends around a poker table, the game showing on the TV

howItWorks.title: Three minutes from the couch to the first deal.

setup.title: Set up your table
setup.description: Name the seats, set the buy-in and the blinds. Your settings are remembered for next time.

scan.title: Your friends scan in
scan.description: A QR code on the TV, a seat to pick, and everyone gets their buy-in. No account needed to play.
scan.shotAlt: Picking a seat on a phone

play.title: Just play
play.description: Bets are recorded, the pot adds itself up, the blinds go up on time. At the end of the night, the tally is ready.

tv.title: The whole table, on the big screen.
tv.description: Cast the game to the living-room screen: the pot, the stacks and the next blind level are readable from the couch.
tv.roomAlt: A living room with the table showing on the wall-mounted TV
tv.screenAlt: The full-screen TV view of a table

blinds.title: Timed blinds
blinds.description: The next level shows up with its countdown.

pot.title: The pot, live
pot.description: Every bet lands on the table the moment it is made.

qr.title: The QR code, always on screen
qr.description: Latecomers join the table without stopping the hand.

phone.title: Your stack, in your pocket.
phone.description: Every player sees their balance and bets with a tap. No more chips sliding around, no more “wait, how much did you put in?”.
phone.handAlt: A hand holding a phone above a pile of chips
phone.screenAlt: A player's stack and actions on their phone

actions.title: Call, raise, fold
actions.description: The game's actions, and only those.

turn.title: It buzzes when it's your turn
turn.description: Put your phone down and talk to the others.

tally.title: The tally at the end
tally.description: Who owes what to whom, worked out before anyone leaves.

gallery.title: Everyone at the table, no one stuck at the bank.
gallery.description: The host gets to play too. {appName} takes care of the rest.

photos.chips: A close-up of a stack of chips
photos.host: The host in front of the TV
photos.table: The table from above, phones lying on the felt

cta.title: Your next game night starts here.
cta.description: Your first table is free. Your friends only need their phone.

loadError.title: Something went wrong
loadError.description: We could not check your link. It is probably still valid — give it another try in a moment.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Give us the email on your account and we will send a link to choose a new one. The link is good for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

resetSent.title: Check your mail
resetSent.description: If an account exists for this address, a link to choose a new password is on its way to:

tips.expires: The link expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
tips.spam: Nothing after a minute? Look in your spam folder.
tips.current: Your current password keeps working until you set a new one.

invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.description: Reset links are single-use and last {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. Ask for a fresh one and it will land in your inbox.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Pick one you have not used before. Your games and your history stay exactly as they were.

done.title: Password changed
done.description: Your new password is saved. You can sign in with it right away.
done.notYou: Did not ask for this? <link>Reset it again</link> straight away.

done.title: Email confirmed
done.description: {email} is verified. Your account is ready to play.

sent.title: Check your mail
sent.description: A fresh confirmation link is on its way to:
sent.spam: Nothing after a minute? Look in your spam folder.

invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.description: Confirmation links are single-use and expire after a while. Ask for a fresh one and it will land in your inbox.

done.title: Account deleted
done.description: Your account and everything tied to it are gone. Thanks for playing with us.

invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.description: Deletion links are single-use and expire after a while. You can ask for a new one from your security settings.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.description: This cannot be undone. You are about to permanently delete the account for:

consequences.data: Your account and all associated data are permanently deleted.
consequences.signOut: You are signed out right away.

oauthErrors.title: Google sign-in did not go through
oauthErrors.access_denied: You cancelled on Google's side. Try again whenever you are ready.
oauthErrors.unverified_email: Your Google account has no verified email address. Verify it with Google, or sign in with your email and password.
oauthErrors.failed: Something went wrong while signing you in with Google. Please try again.

guest.title: Join the table
guest.description: Sign up to host your games and invite your friends.
